levels.surface: أبو نصر محمد بن الحسين البصير

notes: «أخيه موسى بن جعفر» and «أبيه جعفر بن محمد»: relation plus name is one link carrying the name (rule 7).
The bare «أبيه» (second occurrence) and the bare «جده» are relation links; the grandfather is not named in the text and is not identified.
«قال رسول الله» starts the saying; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
